title: Obys — about page ends on a full-width wordmark
note: The about page is 11px text in a few columns (awards, talks, links, "Typography: OTF Obys NG by Obys"), and its lines reveal one at a time behind a mask as they scroll in. The page ends with the OBYS® wordmark set the full width of the screen (about 500px tall), so the logo becomes the footer. Worth reusing: a whisper-small body with a single huge typographic full stop at the end.
